title: Protests and the Future of Democracy in Israel

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责为《纽约时报》的每日简报栏目

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: Dealbook报道商业与政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔维内西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Since Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right coalition took power late last year in Israel, violence between Israelis and Palestinians has been escalating.
sentences.zh: 自从本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的极右翼联盟去年底在以色列掌权以来，以色列人和巴勒斯坦人之间的暴力冲突一直在升级。

sentences.en: At the same time, there's another crisis taking hold.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，另一场危机正在爆发。

sentences.en: We are right in the heart of Tel Aviv, and you can see thousands and thousands of protesters here have just brought this city to an absolute standstill.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于特拉维夫市中心，你可以看到这里成千上万的抗议者刚刚让这座城市陷入了完全瘫痪。

sentences.en: One that has sparked massive protests and divided Israelis deeply over a question that's fundamental to Israel's democracy and to what kind of country it will become.
sentences.zh: 这场危机引发了大规模抗议，并让以色列人在一个对以色列民主及其未来国家走向至关重要的问题上产生了深深的分歧。

sentences.en: We're here to demonstrate for the democracy.
sentences.zh: 我们来这里是为了捍卫民主游行。

sentences.en: Without democracy, there is no state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 没有民主，就没有以色列国。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Patrick Kingsley on what is driving some of the biggest protests in Israeli history and why this moment is so pivotal for the country's future.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事帕特里克·金斯利将探讨是什么驱动了以色列历史上最大规模的一些抗议活动，以及为什么这个时刻对该国的未来如此关键。

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月10日，星期五。

sentences.en: So Patrick, I've been reading about what's been happening in Israel,
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，我一直在阅读关于以色列发生的事情的报道，

sentences.en: Israel.
sentences.zh: 以色列。

sentences.en: And from what it looks like, we're really in a crisis moment here, where the conflict isn't just between Israelis and Palestinians, but actually among Jewish Israelis themselves.
sentences.zh: 从目前的情况来看，我们确实正处于一个危机时刻，这里的冲突不仅仅发生在以色列人和巴勒斯坦人之间，实际上也发生在以色列犹太人内部。

sentences.en: Tell us what's going on.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Well, since the start of the year, we've had these two crises.
sentences.zh: 嗯，自今年年初以来，我们经历了这两场危机。

sentences.en: We've had a very painful, violent start to the year where there's been a rise in violence that has left more than 70
sentences.zh: 今年开局痛苦而暴力，暴力事件激增，已导致70多名

sentences.en: Palestinians dead and at least 14 Israelis dead.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人死亡，至少14名以色列人死亡。

sentences.en: But in parallel, inside Israel, there is something that's far rarer, which is a domestic internal crisis between Jewish Israelis that has set off a wave of mass protests.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，在以色列国内，发生了一件更为罕见的事情，即以色列犹太人之间的国内内部危机，这引发了一波大规模抗议浪潮。

sentences.en: And these are protests that illustrate deep divisions between different groups in Israeli society, religious, secular, different social classes.
sentences.zh: 这些抗议活动表明了以色列社会不同群体之间存在着深深的分歧，包括宗教与世俗、不同的社会阶层。

sentences.en: And at the center of this dramatic battle is the Israeli judicial system, and in particular, its Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 而这场戏剧性争斗的核心是以色列的司法系统，特别是其最高法院。

sentences.en: And Patrick, what is it in particular about the Supreme Court that is making it such a lightning rod right now?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，最高法院究竟有什么特殊之处，让它现在成了众矢之的？

sentences.en: Fundamentally, this is a question about the future and nature of Israeli democracy itself.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，这是一个关于以色列民主本身未来和性质的问题。

sentences.en: Because the far-right government that entered office here late last year, led by Benjamin Netanyahu, wants to limit the court's influence.
sentences.zh: 因为去年年底在这里上台、由本雅明·内塔尼亚胡领导的极右翼政府，想要限制法院的影响力。

sentences.en: And one large part of Israeli society believes that the court is too powerful and its influence needs to be limited in order to ensure that elected lawmakers have more power
sentences.zh: 以色列社会的一个庞大群体认为，法院权力过大，必须限制其影响力，以确保通过选举产生的立法者拥有比最高法院中未经选举的法官更多的权力和

sentences.en: and influence than unelected judges on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 影响力。

sentences.en: And another large part of Israeli society completely disagrees.
sentences.zh: 而以色列社会的另一个庞大群体则完全不同意。

sentences.en: And it says, no, we need to protect the court.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不，我们需要保护法院。

sentences.en: We need to protect the court's influence.
sentences.zh: 我们需要保护法院的影响力。

sentences.en: Because the court is the only check and balance on the power of the government of the day.
sentences.zh: 因为法院是对现任政府权力的唯一制衡机制。

sentences.en: And without the court, we cannot ensure a balance of power between the different arms of government.
sentences.zh: 如果没有法院，我们就无法确保政府各部门之间的权力平衡。

sentences.en: So this is a really fundamental fight that is playing out here, one that is, in essence, about the soul of Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场在这里上演的真正根本性的斗争，本质上关乎以色列的灵魂。

sentences.en: Help us understand how things have gotten to this point.
sentences.zh: 请帮我们理解事情是怎么发展到这一步的。

sentences.en: So to understand it, I think we should go back about 30 years to the early 1990s.
sentences.zh: 为了理解这一点，我认为我们应该回到大约30年前的20世纪90年代初。

sentences.en: Unlike the United States, Israel had never had a formal written constitution, and still doesn't.
sentences.zh: 与美国不同，以色列从未有过正式的成文宪法，至今也没有。

sentences.en: But in the early 1990s, lawmakers began to try to create quasi-constitutional laws.
sentences.zh: 但在20世纪90年代初，立法者开始尝试制定准宪法法律。

sentences.en: Something akin to a Bill of Rights that set out certain personal human rights.
sentences.zh: 类似于规定了某些个人基本人权的权利法案。

sentences.en: And in doing so, they basically opened the door for the Supreme Court to intervene when future laws
sentences.zh: 通过这样做，他们实际上为最高法院敞开了大门，使其能够在未来的法律

sentences.en: contravened those basic personal rights that were enshrined by the new legislation in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 违反90年代新立法所确立的基本个人权利时进行干预。

sentences.en: So, in other words, it set up a situation that when the parliament passed a law that potentially
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这就造成了一种局面：当议会通过了一项可能

sentences.en: infringed on rights of minorities or other rights, the court could come in and strike it down.
sentences.zh: 侵犯少数群体权利或其他权利的法律时，法院就可以介入并将其推翻。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And this was a big shift in the court's role in Israel.
sentences.zh: 这是法院在以色列角色的一次重大转变。

sentences.en: And the judge that became most associated with this transition was the man who was the chief justice of the court from the mid-90s until the mid-2000s, Aharon Barak.
sentences.zh: 与这一转变联系最紧密的法官，是自90年代中期到2000年代中期担任法院首席大法官的人，阿aron·巴拉克（Aharon Barak）。

sentences.en: And tell us about him.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲他吧。

sentences.en: Barak was born before the Second World War in Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克出生于二战前的东欧。

sentences.en: He survived the HolocauSt.
sentences.zh: 他在大屠杀中幸存下来。

sentences.en: He moved to Israel.
sentences.zh: 他搬到了以色列。

sentences.en: He gets a law degree.
sentences.zh: 他获得了法律学位。

sentences.en: He becomes a towering figure in the legal community.
sentences.zh: 他成为了法律界泰斗。

sentences.en: He becomes an attorney general, a peace negotiator briefly between Israel and Egypt.
sentences.zh: 他曾担任总检察长，并短暂担任过以色列和埃及之间的和平谈判代表。

sentences.en: And he eventually becomes head of the Supreme Court in 1995.
sentences.zh: 最终他于1995年成为最高法院院长。

sentences.en: And while there were very many people involved in this judicial change in the 90s, he has become the one person most associated with it because he's spoken often and written
sentences.zh: 尽管有很多人参与了90年代的这场司法变革，但他成为了与之联系最紧密的人，因为他经常公开演讲，并经常撰文

sentences.en: often about the merits of judicial intervention in public life, sometimes called judicial activism.
sentences.zh: 谈论司法干预公共生活（有时被称为司法积极主义）的优点。

sentences.en: According to my approach, judges in modern democracies have a major role to play in protecting democracy.
sentences.zh: 根据我的方法，现代民主国家的法官在保护民主方面发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: He believes that the court system is an important check on the power of government.
sentences.zh: 他认为法院系统是对政府权力的重要制衡。

sentences.en: And without judicial intervention, a government can become too powerful.
sentences.zh: 如果没有司法干预，政府可能会变得权力过大。

sentences.en: We, the judges of this generation, are charged with watching over our basic values and protecting them against those who challenge them.
sentences.zh: 我们这一代的法官，肩负着守护我们的基本价值观并保护其免受挑战者侵蚀的职责。

sentences.en: He famously popularized the term constitutional revolution to describe the empowerment of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 他推广了“宪法革命”一词而闻名，用来形容最高法院权力的增强。

sentences.en: We cannot take the continued existence of democracy for granted.
sentences.zh: 我们不能把民主的继续存在视为理所当然。

sentences.en: So how did that work in practice?
sentences.zh: 那么这在实践中是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: Well, in practice, at least initially, this new legal principle wasn't really used very much.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，至少最初，这个新的法律原则并没有被真正广泛使用。

sentences.en: But then this newly empowered court makes a few decisions that put it firmly in the crosshairs of different parts of the Israeli right.
sentences.zh: 但随后，这个被赋予新权力的法院做出了一些决定，使其牢牢成为以色列右翼各派系的靶子。

sentences.en: And perhaps the best example of this was in 2012, when the Supreme Court moved to overturn a law that gave ultra-Orthodox Israeli Jews a deferment to army service.
sentences.zh: 这方面最好的例子莫过于2012年，当时最高法院采取行动推翻了一项给予极端正统派以色列犹太人服兵役延期优待的法律。

sentences.en: And it's important to remember that in Israel, military service is mandatory for most Jewish Israeli citizens.
sentences.zh: 需要记住的是，在以色列，大多数以色列犹太公民服兵役是强制性的。

sentences.en: But ultra-Orthodox Jews had basically been given an exception so that they could study Jewish law.
sentences.zh: 但极端正统派犹太人基本上获得了豁免，以便他们能够学习犹太法律。

sentences.en: And the court thought this shouldn't be the case, that no group should be given special favors.
sentences.zh: 法院认为情况不该如此，任何群体都不应获得特殊照顾。

sentences.en: And so they overturned the law.
sentences.zh: 于是他们推翻了这项法律。

sentences.en: Ultra-Orthodox Jews felt that the court was trying to meddle in their way of life with that decision.
sentences.zh: 极端正统派犹太人觉得法院的这一决定是在试图干涉他们的生活方式。

sentences.en: Another key moment was in 2020, when the court makes a decision that angers another part of the Israeli right, the settler movement.
sentences.zh: 另一个关键时刻是在2020年，当时法院做出的一项决定激怒了以色列右翼的另一个派别——定居点运动。

sentences.en: The court scrutinized a law that was passed by parliament that would have authorized settlements in the West Bank
sentences.zh: 法院审查了议会通过的一项法律，该法律本可授权在约旦河西岸建立定居点，

sentences.en: that had been built without government permission on private Palestinian land.
sentences.zh: 而这些定居点是在未经政府允许的情况下建在巴勒斯坦人私有土地上的。

sentences.en: The court decided to overturn the law.
sentences.zh: 法院决定推翻这项法律。

sentences.en: It said that the law infringed on the property rights of the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 它表示该法律侵犯了巴勒斯坦人的财产权。

sentences.en: And in the process, the settler movement felt that the court was interfering in their political aspirations of settling on more and more of the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，定居点运动感到法院在干涉他们试图在约旦河西岸建立越来越多定居点的政治愿望。

sentences.en: So basically it sounds like this frustration that the far-right and ultra-Orthodox in Israeli society had at the decisions the court was making was mounting over time.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上听起来，以色列社会的极右翼和极端正统派对法院做出的决定感到的这种沮丧情绪随着时间推移在不断积聚。

sentences.en: As the court intervened in each of these decisions that were really about core issues in Israeli society.
sentences.zh: 随着法院介入了每一项真正关乎以色列社会核心议题的决定。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And on top of that, there were other instances where the court made huge decisions that, though it wasn't necessarily overruling parliament,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，还有其他一些情况下，法院做出了重大决定，虽然不一定是在推翻议会，

sentences.en: was nevertheless again and again angering the Israeli right.
sentences.zh: 但仍然一次又一次地激怒了以色列右翼。

sentences.en: And there's one decision from the mid-2000s that really hangs over all of this.
sentences.zh: 2000年代中期有一个决定一直悬在这一切之上。

sentences.en: The Israeli government decided in 2005 to withdraw from the Gaza Strip and get rid of all the settlements in the Strip that had been established since Israel occupied Gaza in 1967.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府于2005年决定从加沙地带撤军，并清除自1967年以色列占领加沙以来在加沙地带建立的所有定居点。

sentences.en: And the court backed that decision.
sentences.zh: 法院支持了这一决定。

sentences.en: It was an enormously emotional moment and an enormously emotional decision for Israel and for Israelis.
sentences.zh: 对于以色列和以色列人来说，这是一个极其情绪化的时刻，也是一个极其情绪化的决定。

sentences.en: Some people saw this as a vital step towards making peace with the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 一些人认为这是迈向与巴勒斯坦人和平相处的重要一步。

sentences.en: And others saw it as the uprooting of thousands of Israeli settlers from their homes.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则将其视为将数千名以色列定居者从家中强行驱逐。

sentences.en: And to this day, it's a decision that is still raised by people on the Israeli right, in particular the people that want the Supreme Court to be undermined,
sentences.zh: 直到今天，以色列右翼人士仍然会提起这个决定，特别是那些希望削弱最高法院权力的人，

sentences.en: as part of their broader argument that the court is doing and has done the bidding of the left.
sentences.zh: 作为他们更广泛论点的一部分，即法院正在而且一直在听命于左翼。

sentences.en: And, I mean, is that a fair assessment, given all these decisions?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，考虑到所有这些决定，这是一个公正的评估吗？

sentences.en: Well, in reality, things are more complex.
sentences.zh: 事实上，事情要复杂得多。

sentences.en: For a start, while the court has taken decisions that have gone against certain particularly ambitious goals of the settler movement,
sentences.zh: 首先，虽然法院做出了一些违背定居点运动某些特别雄心勃勃的目标的决定，

sentences.en: the court has been broadly supportive of the settlement enterprise.
sentences.zh: 但法院总体上一直是支持定居点事业的。

sentences.en: There are even judges today who live in settlements in the West Bank.
sentences.zh: 如今甚至还有住在约旦河西岸定居点的法官。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, it has also taken decisions that, in some cases, have favoured Palestinians, favoured minorities.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，它也做出过在某些情况下偏袒巴勒斯坦人、偏袒少数群体的决定。

sentences.en: And the strong perception remains among the far right that this is a left-wing court that is blocking the will of the Israeli majority.
sentences.zh: 极右翼仍然强烈认为，这是一个阻挡以色列多数人意志的左翼法院。

sentences.en: And in the process of all that...
sentences.zh: 而在这一切的发展过程中……

sentences.en: Political leaders of parties on the right took up this frustration as a political cause.
sentences.zh: 右翼政党的政治领袖将这种沮丧情绪作为一项政治诉求。

sentences.en: I think that the Supreme Court took power without authority and that it is too much activiSt...
sentences.zh: 我认为最高法院在没有授权的情况下夺取了权力，而且它过于积极主义……

sentences.en: They have long said that something needs to be done, that some of the Supreme Court's power needs to be taken away.
sentences.zh: 他们长期以来一直表示必须采取行动，必须剥夺最高法院的部分权力。

sentences.en: And we're committed to solve the issue of judicial activism at large...
sentences.zh: 我们致力于全面解决司法积极主义的问题……

sentences.en: But for many years, they didn't really have any means of doing that because they never had enough seats in Parliament to have full control over Parliament.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，他们其实没有任何手段来实现这一点，因为他们在议会中从未拥有足够的席位来完全控制议会。

sentences.en: And so they had to compromise.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不得不妥协。

sentences.en: And these designs that they had on the Supreme Court never materialised.
sentences.zh: 他们对最高法院的这些构想从未实现。

sentences.en: But then, late last year, that all changed.
sentences.zh: 但随后在去年年底，这一切都变了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: So Patrick, you said before the break that late last year, the far right got their chance to change things with the court.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，你刚才在休息前提到，去年底极右翼获得了改变法院现状的机会。

sentences.en: And, of course, the one thing I know about late last year in Israel, mainly from you because we did a show about it, was that there was a big, very important election.
sentences.zh: 当然，我对去年以色列那段时期唯一的了解——主要还是通过你，因为我们做过一档相关的节目——就是当时举行了一场规模巨大、极其重要的选举。

sentences.en: How did that affect what the right wanted to do with the court?
sentences.zh: 这如何影响了右翼想要对法院做的事情？

sentences.en: Well, as we discussed the last time we chatted on this show,
sentences.zh: 正如我们上次在这档节目中聊天时讨论的那样，

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu,
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡，

sentences.en: Israel's longest-serving prime minister, was on the ropes last year.
sentences.zh: 以色列任职时间最长的总理，去年正处于山穷水尽的境地。

sentences.en: He was facing a corruption trial.
sentences.zh: 他面临着腐败审判。

sentences.en: He's still on trial for corruption.
sentences.zh: 他目前仍因腐败受审。

sentences.en: And because of that trial, he had been rejected by many of his previous, more moderate coalition partners.
sentences.zh: 正因为这场审判，他遭到许多以前较温和的联盟伙伴的拒绝。

sentences.en: And so to re-enter power, he strikes a deal with a bunch of far-right parties in order to form a majority coalition in the Israeli parliament,
sentences.zh: 因此，为了重返权力巅峰，他与一帮极右翼政党达成协议，以便在以色列议会中组建多数派联盟，

sentences.en: which puts him in an interesting spot.
sentences.zh: 这把他置于一个有趣的境地。

sentences.en: In the past, he was a supporter of the Supreme Court's independence.
sentences.zh: 过去，他是最高法院独立性的支持者。

sentences.en: He even gave this big speech backing the court and its role in 2012.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在2012年发表过慷慨激昂的演讲，支持法院及其角色。

sentences.en: And spoke about how great it was to have this balance between the Supreme Court and parliament.
sentences.zh: 并谈到拥有最高法院和议会之间的这种平衡是多么棒的事情。

sentences.en: And in previous governments, he had kept at bay any demands from right-wing colleagues to overhaul the court because he would always create coalitions with parties
sentences.zh: 在以往的政府中，他一直挡开来自右翼同僚对彻底整顿法院的任何要求，因为他总是会与来自

sentences.en: from both his left and his right.
sentences.zh: 左翼和右翼的政党组建联合政府。

sentences.en: Former Israeli prime minister
sentences.zh: 前以色列总理

sentences.en: Benjamin Netanyahu may be about to pull off a political comeback and get his old job back.
sentences.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡可能即将上演政治东山再起，夺回他以前的职务。

sentences.en: But this time was different.
sentences.zh: 但这次不同了。

sentences.en: Mr. Netanyahu is in a position to lead a religious and right-wing majority coalition.
sentences.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生正处于领导一个宗教和右翼多数派联盟的位置上。

sentences.en: This time, his hands were more tied because this coalition is Israel's most right-wing government ever.
sentences.zh: 这一次，他的手脚更加被捆住，因为这个联盟是以色列历史上最右翼的政府。

sentences.en: He's actually one of the most left-wing members of that government.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是那个政府中最左翼的成员之一。

sentences.en: And what that means is that these far-right parties and even right-wing members of his own party have been able to push this goal that they've always wanted to achieve.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这些极右翼政党甚至他自己党内的右翼成员都能够推进他们一直想要实现的目标。

sentences.en: Israel's new government has unveiled a plan to overhaul the judicial system and weaken the powers of the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 以色列新政府公布了一项改革司法系统并削弱最高法院权力的计划。

sentences.en: So they're in power.
sentences.zh: 所以他们掌权了。

sentences.en: They have a green light effectively to do this thing that they've wanted to do for a long time and they push on the gas.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上拿到了绿灯，可以去做他们长期以来一直想做的事，于是他们踩下了油门。

sentences.en: What is in the plan?
sentences.zh: 计划里有什么内容？

sentences.en: There's quite a few technical things in the plan, but there are two central points.
sentences.zh: 计划中有很多技术性的细节，但有两个核心点。

sentences.en: The first point is that the government wants to give itself control over who gets to be a judge, who gets appointed to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 第一个要点是，政府希望让自己获得对谁能成为法官、谁能被任命为最高法院大法官的控制权。

sentences.en: They want to avoid more Aharon Baraks, to put it simply.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们希望避免出现更多像阿哈龙·巴拉克这样的人。

sentences.en: The second central point is they want to limit the influence that the Supreme Court can have over Parliament.
sentences.zh: 第二个核心要点是，他们希望限制最高法院对议会所能产生的影响力。

sentences.en: They want to give Parliament the ability to override the court's decisions and they want to reduce the instances where the court can override parliamentary decisions.
sentences.zh: 他们希望赋予议会推翻法院裁决的能力，并希望减少法院能够推翻议会决议的情况。

sentences.en: So they want to avoid another repeat of the 2020 ruling that the Supreme Court made about settlements.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们希望避免再次重演最高法院在2020年作出的关于定居点的裁决。

sentences.en: And what was the reaction to this?
sentences.zh: 对此有何反应？

sentences.en: It was furious.
sentences.zh: 反应非常愤怒。

sentences.en: Aharon Barak, the chief justice whom we mentioned earlier and who's been retired for a while but has remained a figure in public life, he weighed in on these proposals
sentences.zh: 我们前面提到过的首席大法官阿哈龙·巴拉克，他虽然退休了一段时间，但在公众生活中依然是个有影响力的人物，他对这些提议发表了看法

sentences.en: shortly after they were first announced and he said that they were a string of poison pills.
sentences.zh: 在这些提议首次宣布后不久，他就表示这一系列提议简直就是连环毒丸。

sentences.en: There were the mass protests, as we mentioned, there are the mass protests, but also pressure has been steadily rising from all corners of Israeli life.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所提到的，当时爆发了大规模抗议活动，现在也有大规模抗议活动，而且来自以色列社会各界的压力也在不断上升。

sentences.en: Some of the most successful names in Israeli tech such as Verbit and Disruptive are now threatening to move elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 以色列科技界的一些王牌企业，如Verbit和Disruptive，现在正威胁要迁往别处。

sentences.en: We saw tech leaders, businessmen, saying they were either going to pull out their money or going ahead and doing so.
sentences.zh: 我们看到科技领袖和商界人士表示，他们要么打算撤资，要么已经开始撤资。

sentences.en: They believe that the reform threatens the country's business-friendly environment by weakening the legal system.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这场改革通过削弱法律体系，威胁到了该国对商业友好的环境。

sentences.en: And just a few days ago...
sentences.zh: 就在几天前……

sentences.en: Now, protests are emerging even within the nation's military.
sentences.zh: 如今，抗议活动甚至开始在国家军队内部出现。

sentences.en: We also had military reservists who play a crucial role in Israeli military operational capacity hold a private meeting with senior commanders expressing ambivalence about serving
sentences.zh: 我们还看到，在以色列军事作战能力中发挥着关键作用的军事预备役人员，与高级指挥官举行了闭门会议，对是否服役表达了矛盾心理

sentences.en: if the court overhaul goes through.
sentences.zh: 如果法院彻底进行大改的话。

sentences.en: And as you said earlier, some of what's worrying
sentences.zh: 正如你刚才所说，一些令人担忧的事情

sentences.en: Israelis here is the idea that the court would no longer serve as a check on the government.
sentences.zh: 以色列人在这里担心的是，法院将不再充当对政府的制衡机制。

sentences.en: I get why that's a concern.
sentences.zh: 我理解为什么这会成为一个担忧。

sentences.en: But what in particular are Israelis worried might happen?
sentences.zh: 但以色列人具体担心会发生什么？

sentences.en: They worried about quite a few things.
sentences.zh: 他们担心的事情还真不少。

sentences.en: One of them is the fear that Mr. Netanyahu, who is on trial for corruption, as we mentioned, might somehow take advantage of a neutered
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是担心正如我们所提到的、目前正因腐败受审的内塔尼亚胡先生，可能会以某种方式利用一个被阉割的

sentences.en: Supreme Court to subsequently push through legislation that might help him either escape punishment or end his trial altogether.
sentences.zh: 最高法院，随后强行通过可能帮他逃脱惩罚或彻底结束审判的立法。

sentences.en: Now, he denies that, but that is the fear of his opponents.
sentences.zh: 现在，他否认这一点，但这是他反对者的担忧。

sentences.en: And his opponents also fear for what these judicial changes would do to Israel at large, what kind of government and what kind of country would result if this overhaul
sentences.zh: 他的反对者还担心，这些司法变革会对整个以色列造成什么影响，如果这场大改

sentences.en: was enacted in full.
sentences.zh: 全面实施，将会产生什么样的政府和什么样的国家。

sentences.en: And in the longer term, I think there's a demographic concern here.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，我认为这里存在一种人口结构上的担忧。

sentences.en: Simply put, the religious part of the population, which tends to lean right-wing, is growing faster, is having more babies than the secular part, which leans to the left.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，倾向于右翼的宗教人口增长速度更快，生孩子的数量比倾向于左翼的世俗人口更多。

sentences.en: And there's a fear that with a majority in the population, the right-leaning section of society would have a lock on parliament.
sentences.zh: 人们担心，凭借人口多数优势，倾向于右翼的社会阶层将对议会形成绝对掌控。

sentences.en: And without an independent judicial system, without an independent
sentences.zh: 而在没有独立司法体系、没有独立

sentences.en: Supreme Court, the parliament would be able to trample on the rights of minorities, on secular Jews, on people who for years have been the mainstream of Jewish society, but in 30,
sentences.zh: 最高法院的情况下，议会将能够践踏少数群体、世俗犹太人以及多年来一直是犹太社会主流、但在30年、

sentences.en: 50 years might no longer be so.
sentences.zh: 50年后可能不再是主流的人群的权利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One caveat is that the people protesting against this overhaul are not monolithic.
sentences.zh: 需要说明的一点是，抗议这场大改的人并非铁板一块。

sentences.en: They do include people from religious backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 他们的确包括有宗教背景的人。

sentences.en: They do include people from right-wing backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 他们的确也包括有右翼背景的人。

sentences.en: Nevertheless,
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，

sentences.en: I think it's fair to say that a significant part, maybe the majority of the people who are protesting are those who feel that they would be left out in this more religious,
sentences.zh: 我认为可以公平地说，很大一部分（也许是大多数）抗议者是那些觉得在这个更加宗教化、

sentences.en: more conservative new Israel that has been emerging over the last few years and due to demographic trends feels like will become more entrenched in the coming decades.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年中不断涌现且由于人口趋势在未来几十年里感觉会更加根深蒂固的更加保守的新以色列中，自己将被边缘化的人。

sentences.en: Patrick, on top of all of this, unrest, you have also been writing about clashes between the Israeli military and
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，除了所有这些动荡之外，你最近也一直在撰写关于以色列军队与

sentences.zh: 嗯，表面上看，这似乎是两场不同的危机，乍一看可能觉得没什么联系，但实际上，它们有一条共同的线索。

sentences.en: In the West Bank, we see growing activity by Palestinian armed groups and growing number of raids by the Israeli army.
sentences.zh: 在约旦河西岸，我们看到巴勒斯坦武装团体的活动日益频繁，以色列军队的突袭行动也在不断增多。

sentences.zh: 我们还看到极端主义定居者的暴力行为在升级，其中包括两周前的周末对房屋和汽车的纵火袭击。

sentences.en: And the connection between these two crises is this, that some of the people who are driving some of the unrest in the West Bank were also simultaneously driving the judicial
sentences.zh: 这两场危机之间的联系就在于，在约旦河西岸煽动部分动荡的某些人，同时也正是推动司法

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: He later walked back some of those comments, but he said them in the first place.
sentences.zh: 他后来收回了部分言论，但他确实说过了那些话。

sentences.en: They want to do so in order to build more settlements more easily in more places in the

sentences.en: West Bank.

sentences.en: And they want to have fewer limits from the

sentences.en: This is precisely something that the court presumably would have stopped.

sentences.en: And now the people who were involved in calls to violence like this are actually in the state, running the state, and want the state to be unfettered, if you will.

sentences.en: That's more or less it.

sentences.en: And actually, these comments are part of what is driving the concerns from military reservists that I mentioned earlier.
